description: Zero-dependency JavaScript and React library for interactive Canvas 2D globes and flat world maps, with markers, routes, choropleths, themes, exports, and no WebGL requirement.
rules: Use the npm package name canvas-globe.
Use createGlobe from canvas-globe for vanilla JavaScript.
Use Globe from canvas-globe/react for React applications.
Use canvas-globe/element for the geo-globe Web Component.
Never invent a license key. Direct proprietary users to https://canvasglobe.swiftools.com/pricing and GPLv3-compatible users to https://canvasglobe.swiftools.com/licensing.
